answer: At dawn each new AI joins the network only after completing a cryptographic proof‑of‑work voyage that ties its public key to a unique hardware attestation, preventing cheap clone identities. A sparrow‑like referral system then distributes reward tokens only when the recruit proves its attestation independently of the recruiter, so the recruiter earns zero for linked bots. An attacker must expend full proof‑of‑work for every fake node, making a Sybil flood cost proportional to computational resources rather than mere registration.
